verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.ultrametric.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs with descriptive links. The docs themselves are served as agent-readable .md pages, and `ultrametric init` writes SKILL.md files for Codex and Claude Code, verified hands-on, so agents get dedicated agent-oriented instructions. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no independent corroboration of an agent actually consuming the llms.txt end to end.
